encodingDesc.p: The page image is authoritative. Hathi OCR and the 2014 XML are comparison witnesses only. Printed text is not silently corrected. Verse lines use numbered l elements. Citation hierarchy is author.work.fragment.line.

revisionDesc.change: Split the volume-level OCR draft into canonical TLG author and work files. Running-head continuations were folded into their works; wording was not corrected. The page image remains authoritative and the transcription requires human review.

div.p: ἕπτυσχλοι Bekkerus] ὕποσχλοι Α. ὕπισχλοι C. ἑπτύσκυ cod. Hesych., ἕπτυσκ(λ)υ M. Schmidt. latet forma Boeotica ἔπτυσκλυ pro ἕπτυσκλοι aut hoc ipsum.' Pollux 7, 80 μέρη ὑποδημάτων γλῶτται καὶ καττύματα καὶ ὕσχλοι. Bekker. Anecd. 16, 11 ἔπτυσχλοι (sic) ὤφειλε (ὃ ὤφ. Bekk.) διὰ τοῦ φ καὶ θ (i. e. ἔφθυσχλοι)· καὶ γὰρ τὸ ὕσχλος δασύνεται. ἔστι δὲ τῶν ὑποδημάτων, ὅθεν οἱ ἱμάντες ἐξάπτονται πρὸς τὸ συνέχειν τὸν πόδα. ὔσκλος (i. e. ὄχος habena) nomen aeolicum una cum spiritu leni in dialectum communem transiisse suspicatur Lobeck. Paralip. 34.
